meta.order: Task 23: the complex-domain bisection — the certified complex 1-atom corner (flint acb, sound)

GL_gauge.lemma: the gauge (w, r) -> (w e^{i psi}, r e^{-i psi}) conjugates the corner's error matrix by unitary diagonals (D_row[n] = e^{-i psi n}, D_col[k] = e^{i psi (1-k)}); the target 1[n+k=1] is invariant on its support, so the value is constant on the orbit — the value depends only on (|w|, |r|, arg w + arg r)
GL_gauge.verdict: VERIFIED machine-exact (the algebraic identity is immediate from the diagonal factors).

theta_monotonicity.measurement: at fixed (|w|, |r|), the value over theta in [0, pi]: theta = 0 is the minimizer in 200/200 random samples (within 1e-12)
theta_monotonicity.verdict: MEASURED (uniform); the analytic proof is named — the theta-slab [0, theta_0] leans on Task 17's real-slice certificate plus this measured monotonicity.

far_w_trace_bound.statement: lambda_max >= [3 + |w|^2/(1-|r|^2)^3 - 4|w||r| - 2|w||r|]/3 >= 16.4 > lambda* for |w| >= 7 (the phases' worst case Re = the modulus)
